messages:
evan: Heads up — publish for sample-sdk blocked by regen-diff + failing sample app auth tests. CI flagged a type rename and ordering differences. @priya @caoimhe

priya: can you paste the CI failure + minimal diff?

evan: CI: nodejs-sdk/regendiff-check failed and nodejs-sdk/test:auth-suite flaky. snippet below:

ci-bot: [build 6201] nodejs-sdk/regendiff-check failed

ci output:
```diff
--- a/src/index.ts
+++ b/src/index.ts
@@ -20,7 +20,7 @@
-  authRetry?: boolean;
-  timeoutMs?: number;
+  authRetries?: number;
+  requestTimeout?: number;
```

caoimhe: looks like typegen 3.2.0-candidate changed field names and ordering. devs ran generator locally on mac (arm) while CI runs linux-x64 with older pinned typegen so regen-diff flagged changes. also note: auth semantics now expect numeric retries with linear backoff vs previous boolean toggle with exponential backoff. tests asserting exact timing are brittle.

priya: quick unblock: pin @redwood/typegen to 3.1.x in SDK packages and open hotfix. long-term: we need a release guard for type shape + semantics changes, and a regression in sample apps that assert internal retry implementation rather than public observable behavior.

evan: created branch hotfix/pin-typegen-3.1 and updated workspace devDeps and package-lock. pushing CI now.

ci-bot: rebuild queued: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/6202 :rocket:

devx-bot: suggestion: add two checks before publish — (1) run typegen in a linux-x64 container to avoid platform ordering diffs, (2) run a heuristic semantic-diff that flags renames/type-changes for fields containing keywords: "retry", "backoff", "auth", "timeout". If flagged, require an explicit changelog entry and owner sign-off.

caoimhe: also recommend adding a test helper for sample apps that asserts "retries happen" without depending on backoff timing (e.g., stub sleep/delay and assert retry count or mock transport). will open small PR to soften existing brittle tests.

priya: file a devex issue and include repro commands (arm vs x64 typegen runs, exact regen command, failing diff) and propose the heuristic rules. i'll triage and schedule a small spike for the lint.

evan: filed devex#512 "typegen publishing: detect auth/retry renames + enforce linux-x64 regen in CI" with logs and repro. PR hotfix link: https://github.com/redwood/sample-sdk/pull/442

caoimhe: once hotfix merges we'll do a patch release to unblock users, then follow-up with a minor release that intentionally accepts the API change and includes a migration guide and explicit changelog callout about backoff default changes.

priya: added a note to the release playbook: "run typegen in linux-x64 container and scan for retry/auth/backoff/timeout field diffs; require changelog entry for semantic changes". thanks team. :white_check_mark:
